## Activity

During November 2018, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 398 captures. Activity was completed through the clinic’s usual operating arrangements, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The reported capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month.

## Image quality

Of the 398 captures, 22 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.5. These images could not be used for grading and are reported separately from images that produced a grading outcome. The result should be considered alongside the overall activity level when reviewing the quality of image capture during November 2018.

## Grading

There were 65 referable results during the month. The median grading lag was 6. This records the midpoint of the time taken for grading and provides an operational measure of the service’s grading timeliness. Together, the activity, image quality and grading figures summarise the reported performance of Harbour Eye Clinic for November 2018.
